title: Agents gain connected-app tools
summary:
Agents gained connected-app tools, text gained a direct Responses API, Gemini 3.8 Flash joined the catalog, and more models gained fallback routes.

Agents gained a Composio MCP server for discovering and using connected apps such as Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and Drive. Enter added controls to connect and manage apps; tool calls use the caller’s own connections. Hosted MCP documentation gained source links, and supporting configuration was merged.

POST /v1/responses adds stateless text generation with JSON and SSE output for 56 configured model targets. Model discovery identifies eligible models, while unsupported models and hosted tools are rejected rather than silently rerouted. Related fixes distinguish requested from used model IDs, retry certain upstream rate limits, and account for cache-write tokens in streamed usage.

The separate, paid-only `google/gemini-3.8-flash` model accepts text, image, audio, and video input and returns text, with tools, search, and a 1,048,576-token context window. The existing `gemini` service is unchanged. Generated API documentation also refreshed its chat model list.

daily.title: Connect apps to agents
daily.text: Connect apps such as Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and Drive in Enter, then make their tools available to agents through the Composio MCP server. Tool calls use the caller’s own connections. [Read the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Direct Responses API
daily.text: Use `POST /v1/responses` for stateless text generation with JSON or SSE output across eligible models. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash
daily.text: Send text, images, audio, or video to `google/gemini-3.8-flash` and get text back, with tools, search, and a 1,048,576-token context window. This is a separate paid-only model; the existing `gemini` service is unchanged. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=google/gemini-3.8-flash).

daily.title: One catalog, three tabs
daily.text: Browse Models, Agents, and MCP in separate tabs on Enter. Search stays within your current tab, and the Community toggle keeps its setting as you move between them. [Browse the catalog](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
